abstract: Characteristics of placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like enzyme) in seminoma was studied. By use of lectin affinity chromatography, PLAP-like enzyme in seminoma revealed extra sugar chains compared to placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP), indicating heterogeneity of the carbohydrate moiety. However, the glycosylation patterns were found to be essentially similar between seminoma and normal testis. On isoelectric focusing, differences in migration patterns were revealed between seminoma-derived and normal testis-derived PLAP-like enzyme as well as between PLAP-like enzyme and PLAP. The differences in charge were mainly due to differences in sialylation of the molecules. The complex pattern of PLAP-like enzyme from seminoma on isoelectric focusing was not altered by neuraminidase treatment, indicating a considerable charge heterogeneity within the population of the enzyme molecules from the tumor.
abstract_ja: セミノーマ由来の胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ様（PLAP様）酵素の特性を検討した。レクチンアフィニティークロマトグラフィーを用いたところ、セミノーマ由来のPLAP様酵素は胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）と比べて余分な糖鎖を有しており、糖鎖部分の不均一性が示された。しかし、糖鎖のパターンはセミノーマと正常精巣でほぼ同様であった。等電点電気泳動では、セミノーマ由来と正常精巣由来のPLAP様酵素の間、およびPLAP様酵素とPLAPの間で泳動パターンに違いが認められた。電荷の違いは主にシアル酸化の差によるものであった。セミノーマ由来PLAP様酵素の複雑な等電点電気泳動パターンは、ノイラミニダーゼ処理によっても変化せず、腫瘍由来の酵素分子には電荷の不均一性がかなり存在することが示された。
